Kai: Heads up — seeing sporadic gRPC streaming stalls from eu-west-1 -> edge egress (ALB + NAT). Streams open, then silent for ~10-30s, then ALB issues RST_STREAM. :thinking:
Maya: Can you paste a trace id or a short timeline? is this only grpc bidi/streams or unary too?
Kai: Only long-lived bidi/streaming (>30s). Example trace: `trace:abc123`
Kai: ```
CLIENT -> SEND_HEADERS (method: ChatStream)
SERVER -> 200 HEADERS
CLIENT -> DATA (streaming payloads)
proxy (edge-nat) -> no data forwarded for 12s
ALB -> RST_STREAM (code: INTERNAL)
CLIENT -> sees ECONNRESET after 13s silence
```
infra-bot: autoscaler: added 2 edge-nodes in eu-west-1 (scale event id sc-4021) :rocket:
Daria: Could be NAT port reuse + 5-tuple mismatch when client resumes? But port exhaustion usually causes new connections to fail, not mid-stream silence.
Maya: What are ALB/GW idle timeouts? mismatch between client keepalive and edge could drop streams silently.
Kai: ALB idle is 60s, edge-proxy keepalive 30s for that pool. We have a known config mismatch here. Also noticed these streams had many prefix-cache hits (served from KV cache) right before the silence.
Daria: Interesting — prefix/KV cache can mask backpressure. If the runtime returns quickly from cache but underlying route goes idle, proxies might not forward keepalives correctly. Worth validating whether the proxy removes flow control windows on cache-hit path.
Maya: Can you reproduce locally with grpcurl and a long stream? Also capture h2dump/tcpdump for the timeframe.
Kai: Repro steps I used: `grpcurl -plaintext -d '{"msg":"x"}' -rpc-header 'x-keepalive: 10' localhost:8080 service.Chat/Stream` then let it run. Attached minimal pcap snippet in ticket.
Daria: Commands to run on edge box (if helpful):
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/stream.pcap port 80 or port 443
sudo h2dump -I /tmp/stream.pcap | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Maya: Nice. Any quick mitigation we can roll?
Kai: For canary I flipped per-route prefix-cache off for the chat route in eu-west-1 and the stalls dropped to 0 in the sample window (5m). Seems correlated.
Maya: That suggests cache-forwarding interaction. For a short-term fix: bump ALB idle -> 120s and align proxy keepalive -> 120s, plus keep prefix-cache off for streaming routes.
deploy-bot: Created rollout: canary(5%) -> 20% -> 100% for config change cfg-9845.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-7892: "gRPC streaming silence through edge when prefix-cache enabled" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7892
Kai: Plan: 1) keep canary prefix-cache off for chat route in eu-west-1, 2) bump idle/keepalive in prod edge config, 3) run targeted tcpdump + kernel socket stats during next reproduction, 4) if root cause is cache path not sending keepalives, implement a small patch to ensure PING/keepalive is proxied on cache hits.
Maya: Sounds good. Can you add the pcap + h2dump output to INF-7892 and schedule a 30m war-room tomorrow 10:00 UTC? :calendar:
Daria: I'll help instrument NAT egress pool metrics and add ephemeral port usage dashboards.
Kai: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maya: If anything else shows up, ping #eng-oncall as well.
